questions.question: The distance between diffraction spots in a SADP is inversely related to:

answers.a: The wavelength of the incident electron beam
answers.b: The atomic number of the elements in the sample
answers.c: The real-space lattice spacing of the crystal
answers.d: The aperture size used in the TEM

questions.question: What does the presence of concentric rings in a SADP indicate?
Which of the following statements is true about the effect of dislocations on TEM SADP?

answers.a: Dislocations lead to the broadening of diffraction spots.
answers.b: Dislocations result in the formation of ring patterns.
answers.c: Dislocations do not affect the SADP.
answers.d: Dislocations cause spot splitting in the SADP.
